combo_label: Phones & Apps × Hot Air Balloons × Frankenstein

entries.clue: The van's job: follow across country and collect a crew that has come down
Cold dead body on the table, raw stuff of an unholy assembly
The climb away from earth, measured in feet per minute
Long bar hauled down to throw power through the apparatus
Spoken message the network stores for someone who never answers
Distant ring where sea and sky appear to meet, all the way round from up high
Nameless being sewn from the dead in Mary Shelley's novel
Warning banner that shoves itself onto a screen the second there is news
Coiled line the ground crew grip to steady a rising craft
Joke picture with a bold caption, forwarded until nobody laughs
Sky-splitting flash the doctor calls down to animate his work
